subject: [PATCH] mm/hugetlb_vmemmap: map the shared tail page writable

reviews.author: Muchun Song
reviews.summary: Reviewer Muchun Song approved the patch, giving it an Acked-by tag and a positive sentiment.

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch fixes a race condition between lockless page cache lookups and the allocation of hugetlb tail pages. When a page is freed and reused as a hugetlb tail page, its refcount can be read as non-zero by a lockless get, causing a write fault when trying to update the refcount with cmpxchg. The patch maps the shared tail page writable instead of restoring RCU protection, which would have added unnecessary overhead. This change ensures that stray writes to tail struct pages are prevented and all hugetlb folios of the same order in the zone remain consistent.
